title: Megurine Luka — Precise Advice〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Oh, is somebody playing the guitar?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But Ichika left to work on her lyrics, and the other girls are already gone.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Does that mean...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, Miku, I suspected it was you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hi, Luka.
Wait, why did you suspect me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I came here to see who was playing the guitar since Ichika and the others had left already.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Lo and behold... Hehe. Looks like I was right. Are you trying to come up with more ideas for their song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. The girls and I managed to come up with some good ones, so I decided to write them down while they were still fresh.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But she's been here all by herself since they left...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I would've helped if you just asked.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I was really just writing down anything that came to mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But it's so clear that she's been putting a lot of thought into this based on how many ideas she's written down.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You seem very invested in this one, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Again, I was just writing down anything that came to mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You say that, but your actions tell a different story, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why do you seem so inspired?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika saying that she started listening to songs sung by me when she was little made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. The girls mentioned that while talking about what they did during elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And those siblings that Ichika told us about...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The girls are trying to do what they can for them, so I began wondering if I could also help them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can't just sit back and wait to see what happens. I mean, they care about each other so much but have to live apart...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To tell you the truth... Ichika came here all by herself right after the girls discovered their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By herself?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. She seemed concerned, so we decided to have a session together and chat for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess I must have been worried.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was afraid. I'm really happy to be talking with everyone like we used to, but I think I got scared imagining everything falling apart again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Miku. I shouldn't be saying things like this right after you just helped us remember how much we all wanted to be together again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's nothing to be sorry about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's only natural to be worried about losing something so precious to you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're probably right.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't blame her... I mean, her biggest wish actually came true.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As elated as she was, a part of her feared that she'd lose them again someday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The more memories you make with someone, the harder it becomes to say goodbye to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika experienced that firsthand, so she feels compelled to try and empathize with her fans. To tell that brother and sister through song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She'll be okay, Miku...
I'm sure they'll hear Ichika's message loud and clear.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And she's probably working on the lyrics for that right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling she's going to write something really special.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what a coincidence. So do I.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, since Ichika's probably hard at work, I'll try coming up with more ideas.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll join you for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You will? Thank you.
